author: Bobby Grayson
description:
Major refactor: lexopt for parsing, hand-rolled shell completions, help output, and man page generation. Trade-off: more code to maintain but full control and smaller dependencies.

Sources:
- 082245d: 'This did require... I had to write my own logic for how arguments are combined into one single state object... my own shell completion generator... my own -h/--help output generator... my own man page generator... While this is definitely a fair bit of extra work, it overall only cost me a couple days. IMO, that is a good trade off given that this code is unlikely to change again in any substantial way.'
title: Replaced Clap with lexopt and custom help/completion generators
